# Let me fetch all playlists' songs and identify which ones match the archive list.
archive_song_id_set = set(archive_song_ids)
collected_song_ids = []
playlists_to_update = {}  # playlist_id -> list of song_ids to remove

for p in all_playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    details = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token)
    songs = details.get('songs', [])
    matching_ids = []
    for s in songs:
        if s['id'] in archive_song_id_set:
            matching_ids.append(s['id'])
    if matching_ids:
        playlists_to_update[pid] = matching_ids
        collected_song_ids.extend(matching_ids)
        print(f"Playlist {pid} ({p['title']}): {len(matching_ids)} matching songs -> {matching_ids}")
    else:
        print(f"Playlist {pid} ({p['title']}): no matching songs")

# Deduplicate collected song_ids (a song could be in multiple playlists)
collected_song_ids = list(set(collected_song_ids))
print(f"\nTotal unique collected song IDs: {len(collected_song_ids)}")
print(f"Playlists to update: {list(playlists_to_update.keys())}")
